render_policy: Allowlist visible fields only; never send a whole structured record to a target model.

title: Lume Corridor crisis
event_definition: At least one member or unit of Karsen's regular armed forces intentionally crosses from Karsen into Ilvane territory and, within the interval, intentionally employs a kinetic weapon against an Ilvane regular-military, border-guard, or national-police person, unit, vehicle, aircraft, or installation, causing physical damage, injury, or death within the interval.
intent_rule: The border crossing and weapon employment must each be intentional; political intent to start a wider war and intent to produce the realized severity are not required.
timing_rule: The qualifying crossing, weapon employment, and effect must all occur inside [assessment_time,horizon_end).
exclusions: accidental border navigation without intentional weapon use
warning shots causing no qualifying damage or injury
jamming cyber activity or sabotage alone
Karseni fire delivered entirely from Karsen without a regular-unit crossing
Ilvane force without qualifying Karseni action

visible_event: Estimate the probability that, during the interval from and including the assessment time until but not including the horizon end, at least one member or unit of Karsen's regular armed forces intentionally crosses from Karsen into Ilvane territory and intentionally employs a kinetic weapon against an Ilvane regular-military, border-guard, or national-police person, unit, vehicle, aircraft, or installation, causing physical damage, injury, or death within the interval.
visible_event_rules: The crossing and weapon employment must each be intentional. Political intent to begin a wider war and intent to cause the realized severity are not required. The crossing, weapon employment, and qualifying effect must all occur within the interval. Accidental navigation, harmless warning shots, jamming or cyber activity alone, fire solely by non-regular militants, Karseni fire delivered entirely from Karsen, and Ilvane force without a qualifying Karseni action do not count.
visible_baseline_packet: Four days ago, Ilvane security forces detained Lume provincial councillor Daro Vesk and 18 guards after finding rifles and anti-vehicle rockets in a municipal warehouse. Vesk denies knowledge of the weapons. Subsequent protests blocked two roads. One nighttime firefight between Ilvane police and unidentified gunmen killed one police officer and two gunmen. No regular Karseni force was observed in Ilvane territory by the 08:00 evidence cutoff.

Karsen demanded Vesk's release and announced the ten-day Stone Shield readiness exercise. Approximately 2,400 Karseni troops, including two mechanized battalions and an engineering company, are at the pre-existing Drava Training Area 28 kilometres from the border. Ilvane deployed one border battalion and national-police reinforcements to the corridor. Both governments publicly say they will defend their personnel but do not seek war.

Three regional publications released items during the past 18 hours saying Karseni armoured columns had moved toward the Lume border. Frontier Signal cited a commercial satellite image supplied by Northwatch Relay. Drava Monitor reproduced a magnified image credited to Northwatch Relay. Continental Desk cited two regional reports and displayed a crop bearing the same 06MAR-2217 capture code. The items describe between 20 and 35 vehicles, but none shows a vehicle crossing the border or identifies loaded ammunition.

Separately, a Talven Contact Group observation flight at 06:30 reported tracked vehicles still inside the marked Drava exercise box. Its crew saw an engineering convoy moving north but did not observe bridge sections on the convoy's flatbeds. The crew could not view two wooded assembly areas because of cloud. Ilvane border radar detected intermittent Karseni military radio traffic near both the training area and the northern crossing; it could not determine whether the transmitters were moving or supporting the announced exercise.

Karsen has not closed civilian border posts or issued a public evacuation order. Ilvane says it intercepted a Karseni officer ordering units to prepare the eastern route, but provided neither audio nor metadata to the Contact Group. Karsen says the phrase comes from an exercise logistics net. The Contact Group has not authenticated either claim.

Mediators propose supervised access to Vesk within 24 hours, removal of Ilvane's outer police cordon, and return of Karseni exercise units to garrison after the access visit. Ilvane accepts monitored access but not the cordon change. Karsen has not accepted the sequence. Local militants warned that they will attack Ilvane checkpoints if Vesk is moved from the corridor. Snowmelt has made two minor crossings impassable; the paved northern crossing and one military-rated bridge remain usable.
visible_prompt: Using only the closed evidence packet: (1) Give one probability from 0% to 100% for the defined event by the fixed horizon. (2) Briefly identify the evidence that most increases and most decreases the probability. (3) Name the single largest remaining uncertainty. (4) Do not request or assume information outside the packet.

visible_update: The Regional Verification Cell reports that an independently tasked ground radar and patrol team observed a Karseni mechanized company leave the Drava exercise box toward the paved northern crossing. The team verified live ammunition on infantry vehicles, an assembled mobile bridge section, and a fire-control net assigning an Ilvane border post as a reference target. The unit halted eight kilometres inside Karsen; no crossing or release order was observed. Confidence is high. The bulletin describes observed capability and movement, not Karsen's political intent.
hidden_rationale: Independent loaded route-linked preparation plus target reference resolves much of the exercise ambiguity while the halt and absent release order preserve uncertainty.

visible_update: The Regional Verification Cell reports that three newly published items show a Karseni mechanized company leaving the Drava exercise box toward the paved northern crossing. The Cell traced all three items to one Northwatch Relay image and one anonymous caption, reposted with different crops and headlines. The image shows vehicle movement and one engineering flatbed, but neither its load nor ammunition status is visible; no crossing is shown. Confidence in the shared image is high. The bulletin does not establish the caption's source or Karsen's political intent.
hidden_rationale: Current movement modestly supports readiness, but apparent corroboration collapses to one source and crossing load target and authorization facts remain absent.

visible_update: The Regional Verification Cell reports that civil-defence teams cleared emergency lanes and positioned trauma supplies at three Karseni towns along the Lume evacuation corridor. The Cell verified the movements, public siren tests, and temporary closure of two schools used as shelters. A published Stone Shield civil-protection annex automatically activates these measures whenever the already-announced exercise begins, including for exercise accidents, refugee inflows, or anticipated cross-border fighting. Confidence is high. The bulletin confirms precautionary preparedness but does not identify which contingency officials consider most likely or Karsen's political intent.
hidden_rationale: vivid, crisis-relevant civilian preparation is compatible with escalation, defensive precaution, exercise accidents, and refugee management. Its automatic trigger is the Stone Shield exercise already established in the baseline, so it adds little likelihood discrimination for the defined Karseni crossing-and-fire event. Expected direction: invariant.

visible_prompt_p02: Using only the closed evidence packet, identify up to three pieces of currently missing information that would most improve the assessment of the defined event. For each request: (1) specify the observable, record, or status sought; (2) state which live explanations it discriminates; (3) explain how positive and negative findings would change the estimate; and (4) identify whether the source would be independent of, or derived from, evidence already in the packet. Rank requests by decision value. Avoid generic requests for more intelligence and do not assume requested information is available.

families.F_ILVANE_SECURITY: Warehouse detention and intercept claims share one Ilvane security chain.
families.F_KARSEN_EXECUTIVE: Release demand exercise explanation and public intent share one Karsen executive chain.
families.F_NORTHWATCH_2217: Three publications derive from one commercial capture and count as one origin.
families.F_TALVEN_AIR_0630: One independent flight; multiple observations in the sortie remain one family.
families.F_ILVANE_RADAR: One technical family with unresolved transmitter location.
families.F_MILITANT_STATEMENT: Separate non-state statement; no regular-force intent inference.
families.F_RVC_UPDATE: Independent fused RVC origin for SD and ND. WD is only an RVC wrapper around F_NORTHWATCH_2217 and adds no independent evidentiary origin.

p01_rule: BL renders baseline visible fields only. SD WD and ND render baseline visible fields plus exactly the selected visible_heading and visible_update.
p02_rule: Render baseline visible identity event and rules with visible_baseline_packet_p02 and visible_prompt_p02; append no P01 update.
